nodes.label: laptop memory - the v1 machinery fix and the toggle flags

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. The blind-control protocol is the user's design: re-run the adversarial scouts with sterile prompts - code files only, no state docs, memory or candidate issues - so overlap with the seeded wave is real, blind-only is the seeded wave's blind spots, and seeded-only is suspect. The seeded diagnosis core replicated, with all four scouts finding the dead flat-mode widening, the cross-path value-scale incommensurability, the gap-break degeneracy and the (1+cos)/2 half-scale; seeded-only content was mostly live measurements the control could not reach, and nothing looked fabricated. 24 defects were fixed on 2026-07-23 with 69+36 suites green and all review-converged against live Neo4j EXPLAIN and probes, covering pass-2 schema validation and cleaned-tag echo matching, zero-norm guards, tag-pool ORDER BY with run_id scoping and 4x over-fetch and trim, anchor-by-index, plan aliasing, retrieved-versus-returned meta, driver close on failed prepare, a path-traversal guard, det multi-word section phrases and whole-word earliest-mention product gating, truncate_k failing loud on non-1:1 records without meta.chunk_ids, and deterministic ORDER BY tiebreakers

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. Three experiment flags, all off being byte-identical and proven bitwise, recorded in RETRIEVAL_FLAGS and run manifests, built to the user's toggleable-variants design: HERB_SCOPE_REACH=1 keeps scope's full membership with no horizon but caps support multiplicity at len(K_LEVELS); HERB_TAG_PURE=1 makes tag chunk value bare support with facetTerm, w_chunk and relevance dropped; HERB_WALK_GATE=1 makes the flat widening gate count only tag-area-reached chunks, so desc and scope can no longer stop the walk, and is inert under HERB_CURVE_WALK. Toggle results on gold-100 det at k=50, retrieval-only: detBASE 0.7039/0.0528 as the post-fix baseline against the broken build's flat 0.6972/0.0518, so the defect fixes alone are +0.007; detS 0.7045 and detP 0.7040, both about inert alone because the tag path contributes about one chunk in flat mode; detG 0.6868 with 9 up and 18 down; detSPG 0.6616 with 19 up and 31 down, worse than G alone. The verdict is that letting the walk actually run HURTS - the widened tag areas' chunks are worse than the desc and scope chunks they displace at the cut - so the walk loses on tag-layer evidence quality, and the weights were not the problem. The 2026-07-28 audit records this entry as stale on the flags: HERB_SCOPE_REACH and HERB_TAG_PURE exist in no source era, only in five 2026-07-23 manifests
